monitor.title: Monitor
monitor.waiting_help: Live data appears when the engine publishes statistics. Enable VICTORY_STATS if it was turned off.
updates.title: Updates
updates.check_on_launch: Check for an update when the launcher starts
updates.offline: Could not reach the update server. Check your internet connection and try again.
updates.found: A new engine build is available.
updates.installed: Installed {name}. It is now the active build.
updates.no_builds: No engine build is installed yet.
updates.rollback: Go back to the previous build
updates.cleanup_ask: Keep the active build, the previous one and the newest others, {n} in all?
dev.title: Developer
dev.diag_help: The diagnostics build prints more to the log and has the in-game performance panel, and runs a little slower.
dev.own_hint: Path to a victory.exe you built
dev.profiler_help: A diagnostics build briefly suspends sampled threads. At 5 ms the measured cost was within noise. Faster sampling can cost more.
dev.flag_added: Added to your extra flags. It applies on the next start.
dev.profile_invalid: Enter seconds for from and to (from smaller than to), a step in milliseconds and a file name.
dev.log_changed: The file has changed since it was loaded. Load it again to see the end.
dev.log_same: No new output since it was loaded.
dev.cache_help: Clearing it makes the next start translate the game's shaders again, which takes a while.
dev.env_help: The VICTORY_* values of the current or last start.
dev.profile_enable: Sample the next time I play
dev.profile_windows_help: Times are in seconds after the engine starts. Windows must not overlap.
dev.profile_threads_help: Maximum threads sampled in each round.
dev.profile_depth_help: Maximum frames unwound per sampled stack.
dev.profile_filter_help: Only sample thread names containing this text. Leave blank for any thread.
dev.profile_folder_help: Profile files are named automatically after each window.
dev.profile_symbols: Resolve symbols when the profile ends
dev.profile_symbols_help: Place the matching PDB beside the diagnostics engine for full function names.
dev.profile_top_help: Limit how many rows are shown and exported.
dev.profile_min_help: Show rows with at least this inclusive share of captured stacks.
dev.profile_merge_help: Combine matching thread names when grouping by thread.
panel.enable: Show the in-game panel while playing
panel.help: Shows frame rate, frame times, graphics card, processor, video memory and RAM in the upper left corner of the game. Press F3 in the game to hide it.
monitor.gpu_nvml: GPU load from NVIDIA NVML, for the whole card.
monitor.gpu_pdh: GPU load from Windows, for the busiest engine used by this game.
monitor.inspect_help: Click the chart to inspect a frame.
monitor.estimate_help: Share of the last frame when the engine's GPU queue had work, estimated from fence timing.
monitor.target_help: Frame-time budget used for the chart and missed interval count.
monitor.activity_help: Durations share a scale and start at each frame boundary. CPU and GPU start times within a frame are unavailable.
monitor.drop_pipeline: Pipeline or binding unavailable or skipped
monitor.drop_budget: Indirect mesh records over the list budget
monitor.no_reasons: No drop reasons reported for this interval.
monitor.occluded: Game window is hidden, the game is not drawing
monitor.rejected: The engine's last Present was declined.
monitor.window_help: Time retained in the visible frame-time chart.
monitor.scale_help: Use a fixed upper limit or fit the visible frame times automatically.
monitor.csv_help: How many recent seconds to include in an export.
monitor.cards_help: Choose which items to show and move them into the order you want.
monitor.refresh_help: Minimum time between updates. Unattended views wake once per second.
monitor.sensors: Read Windows and graphics driver sensors
monitor.sensors_help: Sample live GPU load, temperature, CPU load and RAM while the view is active.
monitor.hybrid_hint: This PC has integrated and discrete graphics. Set VICTORY_ADAPTER to part of the adapter name to choose which GPU runs the game.
